base: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity macOS Perry interface concept, landscape 1536x1024. Both supplied images are STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCES, not edit targets. Strictly preserve their warm ivory paper, real dry charcoal brush texture, expressive hand lettering, tiny round-headed ink character with two eyes, sparse butter-yellow or vermilion accents, exquisite whitespace and restrained dimensional black capsule buttons. Light mode ONLY. Same artist, same product, same scenic mountain-lake Mac wallpaper around the window. Actual functional UI text in precise readable native sans serif; only short expressive headline in brush lettering. The character actively draws/changes the interface. No generic SaaS cards, gradients, neon, glassmorphism, blue AI orb, dashboard, repeated feature grids, dense marginalia, giant cursor, dark panels. One screen, not a collage. Small perry wordmark top left and close top right. Beautiful considered composition like approved first screen, not merely a settings form.
scenes: Welcome first onboarding screen. Refine the approved redraw-the-window composition. Massive beautifully hand-brushed 'oh, hello.' with pale butter-yellow swipe beneath oh; the ink character perches top right drawing the window's inner border, whose bottom stroke becomes a restrained dimensional black 'Let’s begin →' button. Clear secondary text 'I’m Perry. Let’s make something happen.' Restrained delightful, faithful reference.

Connection stage. Expressive headline 'a little connection.' upper left. One sweeping loose charcoal cable flows from tiny Perry on left across generous empty paper toward a beautifully sketched Mac window outline at right. Inside that drawn outline are TWO compact readable native choice rows, not tiles: selected 'ChatGPT' with supporting 'Connect your account', and 'On this Mac' with supporting 'Use an available local model'. Under these one black button 'Connect ChatGPT →'. Bottom left quiet 'Set up later'. The cable has one vermilion connector tip held by Perry. Handwritten tiny 'this is where we begin' beside the cable. Strong art direction yet selection and action immediately obvious.

First conversation stage. Huge airy brush headline 'what’s on your mind?' across upper half. Its final underline curls down into a wide beautifully drawn speech bubble, whose interior is a crisp ivory native input with placeholder 'Ask me something…', small microphone at left and black circular up-arrow send at right. Tiny Perry leans over the bubble's left edge listening. One small suggested prompt below 'Help me plan my afternoon'. Secondary sentence 'Type a thought, or say it out loud.' Quiet bottom right 'Skip for now'. Deliberately no conversation history or dashboard. Composition has artistic tension and asymmetric whitespace, same charcoal on warm paper quality.

Screen access onboarding. Brush headline 'a shared view.' left, clear text below 'Let me see your screen when you ask for help.' Large art on right: Perry gently pulls back a paper corner revealing a delicately pencilled miniature Mac window with three tiny traffic-light dots, butter-yellow light spilling across paper. Bottom-left functional native permission area integrated directly on paper, two simple rows with thin hand drawn dividers: 'Screen Recording' — 'Not enabled'; 'Accessibility' — 'Not enabled'. One black primary button 'Open System Settings →'. Small supporting 'macOS will ask you to grant access.' Quiet 'Continue without screen access'. No false enabled checks; no shield/security claims. Paper cutout and charcoal line are the hero.

Practice onboarding. Brush headline 'your turn.' sweeping across upper left. Supporting text 'Let’s try something small.' Perry at right draws a beautiful single mock document window onto the paper with a loose black line, clean native interior titled 'Practice note', containing 'A little room to experiment.' Small vermilion arrow points from character to this practice document. Along bottom a clearly separated black 'Start practice →' button and quiet 'Skip practice'. Tiny handwritten marginal note 'we can undo this' with curved arrow beside practice document. Spacious sculptural page, ink character doing something meaningful, no card grid.

Onboarding completion shown on the real Mac desktop. Wide mountain lake desktop wallpaper, visible top menu bar and physical black camera notch only. All Perry UI LIGHT ivory. A modest ivory paper panel hangs just beneath central notch like a beautiful page folded over the screen edge, width about 550px in 1536px desktop, height360px, soft realistic shadow. Tiny charcoal Perry sits on its upper paper edge waving. Hand-brushed headline 'right up here.' Supporting native text 'Call me whenever you need a hand.' A restrained keyboard shortcut display '⌃ ⌘ Space'. Small black capsule 'Let’s begin →'. Thin playful charcoal trail curves upward from disappearing ivory welcome window corner lower on desktop into notch tab. Physical notch remains black hardware, not a dark app panel. Show credible small scale and surrounding desktop.

Actual compact NOTCH READY UI on Mac desktop. Show upper desktop area large enough to read interface, scenic wallpaper, macOS menu bar and physical camera notch at top center. Hanging directly below hardware is one LIGHT IVORY paper panel about 460px wide, 230px tall, organic very subtle charcoal bottom rule, beautiful soft shadow, folded upper paper corner. Tiny two-eyed Perry 24px perches at left edge. Small brush script 'I’m here.' with native subdued 'What can I help with?' below. One crisp native composer with 'Ask Perry…', small mic icon and black circular send arrow. Tiny shortcut hint '⌃ ⌘ Space' bottom right. Paper and charcoal feel from reference at restrained actual usable size. Desktop consumes most image. No large floating home window, no oversized mascot or cursor, no dark mode.

Actual compact NOTCH ACTIVE TASK UI on Mac desktop. Same light ivory paper tab anchored directly underneath physical black camera notch, around 460px wide by 290px tall, scenic wallpaper around, native menu bar. Tiny charcoal Perry leans over top edge drawing a short progress stroke with butter-yellow highlight. Native clear title 'Organizing your notes'. Beneath two quiet progress rows: small check 'Found 6 notes' then small animated-looking ink dot 'Grouping by topic'. Below a small hand-drawn divider, one input 'Add a direction…' and native compact 'Stop' button. Tiny 'View details' lower left. White space and readable native text, art confined to edge and progress mark. This must look like a useful intimate Mac companion, exquisitely designed, no cards inside cards, no generic dashboard, no dark app surface.
revision: Use case ui-mockup. Generate light-mode Perry active-task notch UI concept, 1536x1024 Mac desktop screenshot. Reference images define ONLY materials and character: warm ivory paper, dry charcoal strokes, tiny ink person, butter yellow. DO NOT copy oversized headline, large window, or composition. An IVORY panel touches the underside of menu bar centrally, precise width 440px and height 220px in this 1536px image, from x548 to988 and y32 to252. It is small, landscape rectangular, rounded bottom corners, very subtle paper fiber and shadow. NO script headline. At panel top a TINY 24px Perry figure on left, normal native sans-serif title 'Organizing your notes' in 18px, tiny close at right. Below a thin hand-drawn butter-yellow progress stroke.
